name: Beverage Antenna
description: The Beverage antenna is a long-wire, low-noise receiving antenna used primarily on the low HF bands. It is a traveling-wave antenna, typically 1–5 wavelengths long, mounted close to the ground, and terminated with a resistor to provide strong directionality.
modelingNotes: Wire length determines directivity and low-angle sensitivity.
Height above ground affects noise performance and pattern shape.
Termination resistor sets the directionality and reduces reflections.
Ground conductivity influences efficiency and pattern stability.
Orientation determines the primary receiving direction.
